summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing for CRMEvent major update. Extended backend pytest suite to 51 tests total (22 new + 29 existing regression). All 51 pass (100%). New coverage: dynamic Tipologia in Settings + POST /api/settings/usage, event partial update preserving fields, Presence/Team/Shift CRUD (incl. uncovered shift with persona_id null), file upload + download + Maps CRUD, dashboard staff KPIs (all 11 required keys present), change-password (wrong current->400, short new->400, correct->200 + login with new works), forgot-password (200), reset-password invalid token->400, invite (sets invite_status=invito_inviato) + access toggle (accesso_disabilitato), permissions (volunteer 403 on /events /dashboard /persons /settings /companies /deals), volunteer /me/events + /me/events/{id} + /me/shifts + object isolation (404 on foreign event), calendar/status configured:false, calendar/connect 400. Frontend Playwright verified: admin login, Settings add-tipologie_evento, new tipologia appears in Eventi field-tipologia select, StaffVolunteers tabs (presenze/team/turni) render with add buttons, Persons invite-dialog + send-invite present, Eventi row maps-dialog with add-map-button works, calsync shows expected 'Google Calendar non collegato' error toast, volunteer login redirects to /area with 2 vol-event cards, event detail shows presence/role/team/2 vol-shifts/1 vol-map, bottom nav vol-nav-home/profile/logout all present, admin sidebar hidden for volunteer.

issues: profilo-link is nested inside user menu popover (needs click on user avatar to open); works but not directly targetable — minor.

No filters currently rendered on tab-team/tab-turni (filter-staff-* count = 0). Request expected filter-staff-evento_id. Likely EntityManager filters config not passed for these tabs — non-blocking, low priority.

action_items: (Low) Add filters (e.g., filter-staff-evento_id) on StaffVolunteers tabs so admins can filter presenze/team/turni by event.
(Optional) Also expose Profilo link outside the user dropdown or keep as-is (works when menu is opened).
critical_code_review_comments: Dynamic Tipologia bug FIXED: Events form reads tipologie_evento live from /api/settings. Confirmed via UI: adding TEST_UI_Tip in Impostazioni appears in field-tipologia select immediately.
GET /api/settings/usage correctly returns counts across all consumers.
PUT /api/events supports partial update with exclude_unset — preserves nome/citta when only tipologia+ora_inizio are sent.

Volunteer endpoints return dict payloads {events:[]} and {shifts:[]}. Not a list — frontend and previous docs may expect list; consistent with pages so acceptable but worth documenting in API contract.
Volunteer isolation confirmed: fresh event admin-created returns 404 for volunteer /me/events/{id}. Good.
Calendar disabled path returns configured:false and connect 400 — expected behavior with empty GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.
Password change enforces min 8 chars and validates current password; forgot-password does not leak email existence.
File upload persists to storage_utils and /api/files/{id} authenticated GET returns raw bytes with correct content-type.
